Mod.Name: PSX Battle Shadows and Vertex Snapping
Mod.Description: This mod change the look of shadows during battles to match the original PlayStation. A few presets are available, as well as an additional option that gives you access to Vertex Snapping Effect. -REQUIRES 7th Heaven 4.6.0+ and FFNx 1.25.1+ -WARNING: This mod may break often due to changes in FFNx. If you experience issues, disable this mod and wait for an update. -This mod is not compatible with Advanced Lighting or Cosmos Gaia -Additional Author: Pashtarot -Special thanks: Chrysalis, Kuraudo
